title: The relative morphism presheaf and its graph projections
statement: Let $z:Z\to S$ and $x:X\to S$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Define $\operatorname{Mor}_S(Z,X)(T)=\operatorname{Hom}_T(Z_T,X_T)$ for each $S$-scheme $T$, with fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] $Z_T=Z\times_ST$ and $X_T=X\times_ST$. Equivalently its points are morphisms $T\times_SZ\to X$ over $S$; the presheaf maps are precomposition with the canonical base-change maps. Its graph morphism is $(\mathrm{id},f):Z_T\to (Z\times_SX)_T$. Define also the first projection $(Z\times_SX)_T\to Z_T$ and the second projection to $X_T$ (or, equivalently, its composition to $X$). No properness, separatedness or finiteness assumption is needed to define these maps.
